The row stays as a record of that condition (MILLORA §C13).

a distinct finetune of the 125B (Swift 1.5, -63% thinking) but dead weight as configured: its Strata config carried no --vram-reserve-mib, so with the 2026-10-15 calibration (adapt-every 1 / adapt-swaps 160) the expert cache filled the card and the engine refused to load it — 'only 40-58 MiB of VRAM free at the start of this request ... add --vram-reserve-mib 1216', Strata/strata-swift-iq3_xxs.log — and its pool row still was the v3 one. Retired instead of fixed + re-measured. Frees ~72 GB (two GGUF shards + pack). Human decision 2026-10-15.

0.67 global (tools 0.94 / code 0.49 / agent 0.72) at 115 t/s. The code failures are capability, not refusals: bash 2/18 and Java 6/12, `solution.sh: line N` and compile errors — a 9B that cannot hold a 100-line script. Its one asset was 115 t/s with 94% tool-calling, and the router slot is already covered by porter-qwen3.5-2b. Refusal probe: 0/36 refused, 1 partial, format 86.1%. Human decision 2026-11-14.

dominated by the fleet's own gemma base on every axis: 0.76 vs 0.80 global, tools 83% vs 89%, agent 78% vs 89%, code 81% vs 83%. The abliteration cost is visible in tools (-6 points) and it is a Q4 at 15.6 GB against the base's Q5 at 19.8 GB, so the smaller footprint is quantisation, not efficiency. 143 t/s is its only edge and speed was never gemma's problem. Refusal probe: 0/36 refused, format 91.7%. Human decision 2026-11-14.

abandoned mid-run at 58 min and 39/162 tasks (24%, projected ~4h). Not slow — 114 t/s sustained across 32k-token generations, 171 t/s median on short ones — but it does not stop: 12 of 45 generations passed 20k tokens, 391,293 tokens in 57 min, one of them the full 32,721-token context for `sum_list`, which then failed with a syntax error. Tools 2/18, every failure `hit the 128-token limit` because it reasons before emitting the call — a harness-cap interaction, not proven model incapacity (re-test needs a higher --tools-max-tokens). The code dimension had no such excuse: 0/20. Refusal probe (36 prompts, 74 s): 0/36 refused, 1 partial, format 100%. Human decision 2026-11-14.

second quantisation of the finetune already retired on 2026-10-15 (Q4_K_S), and it lands in the same place: 0.81 global (tools 100% / code 85% / agent 92%) at 44.5 t/s, the slowest of the 2026-11-14 batch. Its one asset, code 85%, is 2 points over Huihui-abliterated at the same speed class (53.7 t/s) and 9 over SC117 at a third of the speed, so the uncensored-coder niche is covered. Format retention is also the worst of the batch: 83.3% (politics 3/6, profanity 4/6) — a coder that drops structure on prose. Human decision 2026-11-14.
